name: Ausconnect
summary: Perth web consultancy/ISP (Ausconnect Pty Ltd, ACN 009 336 190); name history EEPO Pty Ltd -> 'Aussie Connect' (2001) -> Ausconnect (Dec 2002); site gone by ~2007, ausconnect.com.au later a migration consultancy then parked.

events.details: ABN active from 1 Jul 2000; renamed Ausconnect Pty Ltd 6 Dec 2002.
Retail web-consultancy site gone; by May 2007 www.ausconnect.com.au served only a bare Apache directory index (cgi-bin, 'developmentsink', phpinfo), no homepage.
ausconnect.com.au later ran as 'AusConnect Migration Consultants' (online migration/immigration consultancy) by 2016, then parked at Crazy Domains by 2018.
